title: Minimum Underlying Limits Table for the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy
content:
Each tier of the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy sets, line by line, the minimum limit an underlying policy scheduled beneath it must carry. The figures are in US dollars and are read from the column of the umbrella's own tier.

| Underlying line and limit | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowners policy, Coverage E | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Condominium policy, personal liability | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Renters policy, personal liability | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 |
| Landlord dwelling policy, premises liability | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Auto policy, bodily injury per person | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 | 500000 |
| Auto policy, bodily injury per accident | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Auto policy, property damage | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 250000 |
| Watercraft policy, liability | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 300000 | 500000 | 500000 |

## Notes to the table

1. The homeowners figure is a minimum for Coverage E, the personal liability coverage of a homeowners policy. The condominium and renters figures are minimums for personal liability, the landlord dwelling figure for premises liability, and the watercraft figure for liability.
2. An auto policy is measured against three minimums at once: bodily injury per person, bodily injury per accident and property damage. Each of the three is a separate minimum for that auto policy.
3. The minimums change between tiers at different points for different lines. The homeowners and landlord dwelling minimums rise to 500000 from Larkspur Umbrella 4M; the condominium and watercraft minimums rise to 500000 from Larkspur Umbrella 5M; the renters minimum and the auto bodily injury per person minimum rise to 500000, and the auto property damage minimum to 250000, only on Larkspur Umbrella 10M. The auto bodily injury per accident minimum is 500000 on every tier.

## Hypothetical readings

- *Hypothetical:* a homeowners policy with Coverage E of 300000 meets the homeowners minimum on Larkspur Umbrella 1M, 2M and 3M, and is below the minimum on 4M, 5M and 10M.
- *Hypothetical:* an auto policy carrying 250000 per person, 500000 per accident and 100000 property damage meets all three auto minimums on 1M through 5M; on Larkspur Umbrella 10M its per person figure and its property damage figure are each below the minimum.
